entries.en: Ughh… the road is killing me.
I hate sand. It is coarse, rough, irritating and gets in everywhere!
entries.ro: Urăsc nisipul. E aspru, iritant și se bagă peste tot!

entries.en: In my opinion, you need to put that away.
entries.ro: Eu zic să pui aia la loc.

entries.en: There is no need for you to draw your weapon.
Ai, ai, ai, watch yourself, or you will fall.
entries.ro: Ai, ai, ai, ai grijă, că cazi!

entries.en: Hello…? I cannot hear you… Oh, now I can…! What happened…?
entries.ro: Alo…? Nu te aud… A, acum te aud…! Ce s-a întâmplat?

entries.en: Did you hear about Kirk…? He did not make it…
entries.ro: Ai auzit de Kirk…? N-a scăpat…

entries.en: Ah, I was starting to worry. Where are you…? The west side…? That is quite far, eh…?
entries.ro: Ei, începeam să mă neliniștesc. Unde ești…? Pe partea de vest…? E cam departe, nu?

entries.en: If only, but I do not believe he was drunk this time… It has been a week…
entries.ro: Mă rog, dacă ar fi fost așa… Dar nu cred că era beat de data asta… A trecut o săptămână…

entries.en: Ha, ha, ha, I also was not a fan, but family is family… Mm, yes.
entries.ro: Ha, ha, ha, nici eu nu eram fan, dar familia e familie… Mm, da.
